Persist authenticated operation progress activity (#153)

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: fewensa-17
  description: |-
    ## Summary
    
    - Add a closed, versioned operation progress v2 request with monotonic sequence, bounded activity kinds, and digest-only evidence.
    - Resolve trusted callback authority through the active profile, operation, dispatch, runtime reference, and frozen catalog before atomically updating the lifecycle-v2 activity projection.
    - Route MCP and Codex progress callbacks through the shared durable store while preserving legacy v1 acknowledgement behavior without lease renewal.
    - Add focused schema, catalog, replay/conflict, authority, and projection coverage.
    
    ## Verification
    
    - `cargo check -p codeon-tracker -p codeon-postgres -p codeon`
    - `cargo test -p codeon-tracker operation_progress` (1 passed)
    - `cargo test -p codeon-postgres --lib agent_dispatch_store` (10 passed)
    - `cargo test -p codeon --lib mcp::implementation::tests` (58 passed)
    - `cargo test -p codeon --lib execution::agents::codex::tests` (75 passed)
    - Touched-file rustfmt check and `git diff --check`
    
    The PostgreSQL projection acceptance test compiled but was skipped because this environment did not provide an isolated disposable PostgreSQL target.
